plan.title: feat(scope,swarm): story-ready and pre-PR verify parent lineage not only child AC

narratives.Description: Story-ready, dispatch, and pre-PR gates verify child acceptance only. After #3238 coverage artifacts exist, a green child can still contradict parent invariants. This story adds lineage checks using authored parent IDs and coverage from #3238.
narratives.UserStory: As an operator, I want pre-PR and story-ready to fail when the child contradicts an approved parent invariant, so that a green child implementation cannot pass against wrong lineage.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: After #3238 ships coverage artifacts, extend packages/core/src/story-ready and pre-PR/preflight surfaces to verify parent requirement coverage and approved behavioral deltas for the active child xBRIEF. Fail closed on missing parent coverage or undeclared deltas. Tests under story-ready and preflight. Run vitest and task check. Cite #3241 in CHANGELOG.md. depends_on story 3238.
narratives.Overview: feat(scope,swarm): story-ready and pre-PR verify parent lineage not only child AC
narratives.NonGoals: Out of issue scope; see epic #3237 current-shape.
narratives.AcceptanceJustification: Acceptance items from locked epic contracts.

narrative.Acceptance: Given a child xBRIEF missing parent coverage artifacts after #3238 schema lands, when story-ready runs, it exits non-zero.
Given a child that contradicts a parent forbidden invariant without an approved delta, when pre-PR verification runs, it exits non-zero.
Given full coverage and no contradictions, when story-ready runs, lineage checks pass.

verify_commands: pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/story-ready packages/core/src/preflight packages/core/src/scope
swarm.acceptance_criteria_justification: Items map to locked contracts / issue AC.
